features.agentBridge: AI agent bridge for tool access

agentUpdateBanner.modeAutoDescription: Future signed manifests will apply automatically on the next heartbeat after each release is promoted to canary — no manual approval required.
agentUpdateBanner.modeManualDescription: Future signed manifests will be downloaded and verified on your server, but will NOT apply until you explicitly click Update Now.
agentUpdateBanner.securityNoteAuto: Security note: every manifest is still ML-DSA-65 signed by the platform and verified on your server before apply. Auto mode speeds up rollout; it does not weaken verification.
agentUpdateBanner.headsUpManual: Heads up: Manual mode gives you final say over when updates apply, but if you forget to approve, your server will drift from the latest canary/stable version.
agentUpdateBanner.applyDescription: A signed update command is in flight on the server. The enforcer is staging {target}, running pre-flight checks, flipping symlinks, and restarting services. This usually takes 10-20 seconds; the banner will refresh automatically when it's done.
agentUpdateBanner.pendingDescription: Manifest v{version} is staged, verified, and waiting on your go-ahead. Bundles are already downloaded on the server — applying is a fast service restart.
agentUpdateBanner.applyDialogDescription: Manifest v{version} is signed by the platform and verified on your server. The bundles are already on disk — applying flips symlinks and restarts a few services.
agentUpdateBanner.applyWhatHappens: What happens: the enforcer flips release symlinks and restarts file-api, agent-bridge, watchdog, and term-proxy. Expect a brief (~10-20s) interruption of the terminal, code browser, and AI chat. Your project files, databases, and sessions are untouched.
agentUpdateBanner.applyIfBreaks: If anything breaks: the enforcer automatically rolls back to the previous version on component failure or crash-loop detection. No manual recovery needed.
agentUpdateBanner.lastFailedPartial: Some components restarted successfully; one or more failed and were rolled back.
agentUpdateBanner.lastFailedFull: Every component in the last manifest was rolled back after a failed apply.
agentUpdateBanner.lastFailedSuffix: Your server is running on the previous version.
agentUpdateBanner.lastFailedHint: The next manifest published by the platform will automatically retry on this server. If this keeps failing, check the enforcer log on the VPS for the full stack trace.
agentUpdateBanner.rolledBackDescription: The most recent manifest was rolled back. Your server is stable on the previous version. The next published manifest will try again.
agentUpdateBanner.waitingHeartbeatDescription: Manifest v{version} is available. Your server will pull, verify, and stage it on the next heartbeat (within 10s), then appear here as ready to apply.
agentUpdateBanner.serverOnlineDescription: {enforcer}No install report yet this boot — that's normal if the server is already on the current manifest. The next platform release will apply automatically.
agentUpdateBanner.waitingFirstPingDescription: This server hasn't checked in yet. Platform version and health will appear here within ~60s of the enforcer coming online. You can still switch between Auto and Manual update modes — the setting takes effect on the next sync.

liveness.tooltipOnline: Server pinged within the last 2 minutes.
liveness.tooltipStale: Server's last liveness ping was delayed. Still reachable but slower than expected.
liveness.tooltipOffline: Server has missed multiple liveness pings. It may be down, firewalled, or mid-reboot.

mode.tooltipAuto: Auto: your server applies every verified manifest immediately on the next heartbeat.
mode.tooltipManual: Manual: your server stages + verifies updates but waits for you to apply them.

agentUpdateBanner.toggleDescriptionAuto: Verified manifests apply automatically on the next heartbeat. Toggle off to review each update before it lands.
agentUpdateBanner.toggleDescriptionManual: Verified manifests stage on the server and wait for your approval. Toggle on to apply updates automatically.

privacy.metaDescription: ellul.ai Privacy Policy - How we collect, use, and protect your data
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

introduction.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: ellul.ai ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our cloud development platform.

informationCollected.heading: 2. Information We Collect
informationCollected.paymentBody: Payment processing is handled entirely by Stripe. We do not store credit card numbers or banking details. We only receive confirmation of payment status and subscription information from Stripe.

doNotCollectBullets.body: We have zero access to files, code, or data on your servers
Your SSH keys are transmitted once during provisioning and immediately forgotten
We do not log, record, or monitor your terminal activity
Environment variables are encrypted client-side and we cannot decrypt them

howWeUse.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Provision and manage your cloud servers
Process payments and manage subscriptions
Send important service notifications
Detect and prevent abuse of the platform
Improve the Service and develop new features
Comply with legal obligations

dataSharing.heading: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.intro: We share your information only with:
dataSharing.legalBody: We may disclose information if required by law, court order, or government request, or to protect our rights, property, or safety.
dataSharing.noSaleEmphasis: We do not sell your personal information
dataSharing.noSaleSuffix: to third parties for marketing purposes.

security.heading: 5. Data Security
bullets: All data transmitted over HTTPS/TLS encryption
Sensitive data encrypted at rest (AES-256)
Per-server JWT secrets for terminal authentication
Zero-knowledge encryption for user secrets (BYOK)
Regular security audits and monitoring

bullets.body: Data retained while your account is active
Server data permanently deleted upon server deletion
Account data deleted within 30 days of account closure
Some data may be retained longer if required by law

rights.heading: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

bullets.body: Request a copy of your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your account and data
Request your data in a portable format
Object to certain processing of your data

rights.outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at

cookies.heading: 8. Cookies

bullets.body: Session cookies to keep you logged in
Secure cookies for web terminal authentication

cookies.outro: We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics that track you across websites.

transfers.heading: 9. International Transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be processed in the European Union (Hetzner servers) and the United States (Stripe, cloud services). We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for international data transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.

children.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Service is not intended for users under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

changes.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or through the Service. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
